extraction.name: DocVQA
extraction.description: A dataset for Visual Question Answering (VQA) on document images. It consists of 50,000 questions defined on 12,767 document images of varied types and content.
extraction.creator: Minesh Mathew (CVIT, IIIT Hyderabad, India); Dimosthenis Karatzas (Computer Vision Center, UAB, Spain); C.V. Jawahar (CVIT, IIIT Hyderabad, India)
extraction.citeAs: Minesh Mathew, Dimosthenis Karatzas, C.V. Jawahar. DocVQA: A Dataset for VQA on Document Images. arXiv:2007.00398v3 [cs.CV] 5 Jan 2021.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The authors downloaded documents from various collections within the UCSF Industry Documents Library and manually hand-picked specific pages for the dataset, prioritizing pages with tables, forms, lists, and figures.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis; Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Document images sourced from the UCSF Industry Documents Library, comprising 6,071 documents from the tobacco, food, drug, fossil fuel, and chemical industries.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Remote workers were shown a document image and asked to define at most 10 question-answer pairs on it. Workers were instructed to ask questions which can be answered using text present in the image and to enter the answer verbatim from the document.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: In a second stage, a worker verified the data by entering answers for the questions and assigning question types, with an option to flag inapt questions. If answers from the first and second stages did not match exactly, the question was sent to a third stage where authors reviewed, edited, accepted, or ignored it.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset contains named entities such as names of people, institutions and places, as well as photographs of people.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Visual Question Answering (VQA) on document images; driving Document Analysis and Recognition (DAR) algorithms to conditionally interpret document images.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: During the second annotation stage, questions flagged by workers as inapt due to language issues or ambiguity were excluded from the dataset. In a third stage, questions with mismatched answers between the first two stages were reviewed by the authors, who either edited and accepted them or ignored them.
